lines.text: The LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and the nations will escort Israel to its homeland.
A song of contempt is sung against the king of Babylon, because the LORD has broken the staff of the wicked.
The cypresses and cedars of Sinai exult over the king of Babylon, since no woodcutter comes against them.
The day star said he would raise his throne above God's stars, but he will be brought down to the Pit.
